description: Individual purchases for a category or a merchant: the window total plus the matching transactions. It loads its own data. Plain terms like 'restaurants', 'groceries' or 'gas' resolve to categories; omit both filters for all spending. Do NOT use this when the user asks how much they spent over the last 3, 6 or 12 months — that is a period comparison, so use trend_card with chartStyle:'bar' instead.
